newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: ALBANIA, Jan 14 - Durres - Eight vessels in port, all discharging, of which 1 bagged flour, 2 rice, 1 wheat flour, 1 nitrates, 1 wheat, 1 containers, 1 bulk cement. 2 Vessels in roads awaiting berths of which 1 to load phosphate, 1 to discharge rice.

BULGARIA, Jan 5-13 - Bourgas - 21 Vessels in port operating of which 14 loading (1 ammonium nitrate, 1 general cargo, 1 polyacryl, 1 bentonite, 1 clinker, 6 steel, 1 copper concentrates, 1 chemicals, 1 baryte concentrate). 7 Discharging (2 sugar, 1 coal, 1 concentrates, 1 cotton, 1 petrol, 1 methanol). 14 Vessels waiting in roads of which 9 to load (1 cars, 3 steel, 1 chemicals, 1 general cargo, 1 metal, 1 benzene, 1 clinker). 6 To discharge (1 sugar, 2 coal, 1 chemicals, 1 petrol, 1 clinker), 1 cargo not nominated.

Varna - Varna east, Varna west, Balchik, Teps - 41 Vessels in port operating of which 26 loading (1 cement, 3 sas, 1 ply-wood, 6 soda, 1 clinker, 2 glass, 5 fertiliser, 4 scrap, 1 tsp, 1 ntp, 1 phosphoric acid). 11 Discharging (2 coal, 1 coke, 5 phosphorite, 1 sugar, 1 rice, 1 cars). 3 Discharging/loading containers, 1 discharging/loading trucks. 22 Vessels waiting in roads of which 6 to load (3 scrap, 1 sas, 1 soda, 1 sugar). 2 To discharge (1 rice, 1 coal), 14 cargo not nominated. Jan 13 - A general strike is expected to start 20 January. Varna - Varna east - 8 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge, 3 awaiting orders.

Varna west - 7 Vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge. Varna Lesport/tanker berth - No vessels. Bourgas - Bourgas east - 7 Vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth. 9 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 5 waiting to discharge, 2 under repair/dry-docked, 22 due. Bourgas west - 4 Vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth. Tanker berth - 1 Vessel loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth.

CROATIA, Jan 13 - Rijeka - Two vessels discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth, 4 anchored, 3 under repair/dry-docked, 1 newly-built vessel, 7 due. Zadar - One vessel discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth. Pula, Rasa, Sibenik, Split, Ploce, Dubrovnik - No vessels.

CYPRUS, Jan 14 - Limassol - One container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 7 conventional vessels discharging at berth. 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to discharge/load, 1 bunkering. 6 Vessels due 15/1 of which 2 containers, 2 conventional vessels, 2 passenger vessels. Larnaca - One container vessel discharging/loading at berth, 2 conventional vessels discharging at berth. 3 Vessels due 15/1 of which 1 containers, 2 conventional vessels.

ESTONIA, Jan 13 - No labour problems. Tallinn - City port - 3 Vessels loading at berth (1 map, 1 dap, 1 pig iron). 2 Discharging at berth (both cocoa beans). 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 4 due. Kopli - 1 Vessel loading at berth (non-ferrous metal). 4 Discharging at berth (1 meat, 2 cocoa beans, 1 fish). 4 Vessels due. Muuga - 4 Container vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth (1 barley, 4 containers). Parnu - Five vessels loading at berth (3 timber, 1 boards, 1 briquettes), 6 due.

ITALY, Jan 14 - Naples, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Gaeta - One bulk carrier etb 14/1. Genoa - Commercial port - 5 Vessels in roads, 41 berthed, 3 dry-docked. Multedo - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays. 5 Vessels berthed. Savona - Two vessels in roads, 6 berthed. Vado Ligure - No vessels in roads, no delays. 1 Vessel berthed. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays. 8 Vessels berthed, 5 under repair/dry-docked. Leghorn - Seven vessels in roads, 37 berthed. Civitavecchia - Eight vessels in roads. Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Augusta (oil harbour), Syracuse (oil harbour), Palermo, Ancona/Falconara, Trieste - No vessels in roads, no delays. Sarroch, Venice - No delays. Taranto - Five vessels in roads. Ravenna - Eight vessels in roads.

LATVIA, Jan 14 - No strikes at any port. Ventspils - Eight vessels in port of which 6 operating as follows, 1 steel loader, 1 mop loader, 2 steel/steel billets, 1 wood loader, 1 timber loader. 2 Vessels waiting, 12 due, no delays. Riga - 16 Vessels in port of which 14 operating as follows, 5 timber loaders, 1 cotton loader, 2 container loaders, 1 sap metal loader, 2 metal loaders, 2 urea loaders, 1 fish discharger. 2 Vessels waiting, 15 due, no delay. Liepaja - Ten vessels in port of which 9 operating, 1 waiting, none due, no delays.
LITHUANIA, Jan 14 - Klaipeda - 14 Vessels loading (1 timber, 7 fertiliser, 3 steel coils, 1 ingots, 1 sun flower pellets, 1 scrap). 3 Discharging (2 fish, 1 fish meal). 3 Vessels in roads, 28 due.

POLAND, Jan 14 - Szczecin - 40 Vessels loading at berth, 25 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge. 8 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 1 awaiting orders, 67 due. Gdynia - Ten vessels operating of which 4 loading at berth (1 bulker, 2 general cargo, 1 coal). 6 Discharging at berth (1 bulker, 3 general cargo, 2 gin). 4 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, no vessels waiting, 31 due. Gdansk - Eight vessels operating of which 4 loading at berth (2 bulkers, 2 grain). 4 Discharging at berth (1 grain, 1 general cargo, 2 bulkers). 2 Coal vessels waiting, 4 vessels under repair/dry-docked, 18 due.

PORTUGAL, Jan 13 - Sines - Four vessels in port operating of which 3 discharging (1 coal, 2 crude). 1 Loading butane/propane, 1 waiting to load fuel oil. 8 Vessels due of which to discharge (4 coal, 1 crude, 1 chemical naphtha, 1 metallic structures), 1 to load pro-pylene. Setubal, Jan 14 - Three vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging at berth, 8 under repair/dry-docked. 11 Vessels due of which 8 to discharge, 2 to load, 1 for repair/dry-dock.

ROMANIA, Jan 13 - Constantza - 55 Vessels operating of which 26 general cargo (24 loading, 2 discharging), 12 bagged chemicals (11 loading, 1 discharging), 12 bulkers (9 loading, discharging), 1 bagged cement, 2 containers (all loading), 3 tankers (2 loading, 1 discharging). 5 Vessels waiting in roads of which 4 to load (3 general cargo, 1 bagged chemicals), 1 tanker to discharge. Constantza south (Agigea) - No vessels. Mangalia - No vessels. Midia - Four livestock carriers loading, no vessels waiting.

RUSSIA - BALTIC PORTS, Jan 13 - St. Petersburg - Commercial port - 24 Vessels operating of which 14 loading (5 non-ferrous metals, 3 containers, 4 fertiser, 2 cellulose). 10 Discharging (2 frozen meat, 2 containers, 1 milk products, 1 mixed feed, 1 pipes, 1 bananas, 1 rice, 1 zinc concentrate). 4 Vessels waiting, 6 due. Jan 14 - No strikes. Kaliningrad - Ten vessels in port, all operating, of which 2 aluminium loaders, 3 urea loaders, 3 coal loaders, 1 container loader, 1 meat discharger. No vessels waiting, none due, no delays. Vyborg - Three vessels in port, all operating, none waiting, 4 due, no delays.

FAR EAST ports, Jan 14 - No delays/strikes/congestion at any port. Vladivostok - 18 Vessels in port of which 9 loading (1 containers, 4 metal, 2 timber, 1 general cargo, 1 wood-pulp). 2 Discharging (1 rice, 1 coke), 2 passenger vessels, 5 waiting. Nakhodka - 12 Vessels in port of which 9 loading (3 metal, 5 timber, 1 cotton), 3 waiting. Vostochny - 11 Vessels in port of which 5 loading (2 timber, 1 clinker, 1 metal, 1 coal). 3 Loading/discharging containers, 3 vessels waiting. Posyet - Two vessels in port, both loading, of which 1 ore, 1 metal. Zarubino - No vessels.

NORTHERN BASIN, Jan 14 - Murmansk - Eight vessels operating of which 3 alumina, 1 npk, 1 apatite, 1 steel, 1 iron ore pellets, 1 cabotage. 5 Alumina dischargers waiting. 11 Vessels due during the week of which 9 loaders (4 apatite, 1 coal, 1 scrap, 1 npk, 2 steel), 2 alumina dischargers.

SLOVENIA, Jan 13 - Koper - 12 Vessels berthed of which 3 loading/discharging (1 containers, 2 cars). 2 Discharging (1 bulk carrier with soya, 1 reefer with bananas). 6 Loading (1 bulk carrier with coal, 2 livestock vessels loading bulls, 3 general cargo loading rails/paper/general cargo). 1 Passenger vessel changing crew, 13 vessels due over the next 2 days of which 5 container vessels to load/discharge, 2 car carriers to load/discharge. 3 Vessels to load (1 bulk carrier for coal, 2 livestock vessels for bulls), 2 general cargo vessels to load paper/sawn timber. 1 Tanker to discharge gasoline. No delays expected.

SPAIN, Jan 13 - Aviles - Nine vessels in port of which 5 loading (1 steel, 1 spares, 1 tar, 1 clinker, 1 aluminium). 4 Discharging (1 petcoke, 1 coal, 1 scrap, 1 iron ore). Gijon - Seven vessels in port of which 3 loading (1 sugar, 1 cement, 1 steel pieces). 4 Discharging (1 iron ore, 1 cement, 1 fertiliser, 1 profiles). Stevedores strike still in progress, no change. Bilbao - 21 Vessels operating (20 dry cargo, 1 tanker) of which 15 discharging, 4 loading/discharging, 2 loading, no delays. Jan 14 - Cadiz - 15 Vessels operating of which 4 ro/ros, 1 tobacco, 2 sand, 1 molasses, 1 semolina, 1 wheat, 1 shipbuilding materials, 1 aluminium, 3 under repairs, no delays.

TURKEY, Jan 13 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 8 Vessels operating of which 4 containers, 3 dry cargo, 1 ro/ro, no berthing delays. Galata - 7 Cargo/passenger vessels operating, port congested. Ambarli - 13 Vessels operating, no berthing delays.

UKRAINE, Jan 13 - Mariupol - Seven vessels loading at berth (2 sunflower seeds, 2 fertiliser, 1 sulphur, 2 metal products). 4 Discharging at berth (1 alumina, 1 fluorspar, 2 general cargo). 6 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (1 metal products, 1 urea, 1 coal, 3 fertiliser). 8 Floating storehouses (1 sulphur, 7 fertiliser). 1 Vessel under repair/dry-docked. 17 Vessels due of which 7 to discharge (1 oranges, 2 general cargo, 3 containers, 1 alumina). 10 To load (1 fertiser, 5 metal products, 2 coal, 1 sulphur, 1 sunflower seeds). Kerch - Three vessels loading at berth (1 ore, 2 metal products). 6 Vessels under repair/dry-docked. 1 Vessel waiting at anchorage to load metal products. 2 Vessels due of which 1 to load metal products, 1 ore.

Berdyansk - Three vessels loading at berth (1 sun flower seeds, 2 metal products), 1 discharging oranges at berth, 1 sunflower seed meal vessel due. Mariupol - Ten vessels in port operating of which 6 loading (1 sunflower seeds, 3 steel, 2 fertiliser). 3 Discharging (1 miscellaneous, 1 equipment, 1 flourspar). 5 Vessels waiting in roads, all to load, of which 1 steel, 3 fertiliser, 1 sunflower seeds. 21 Vessels due of which 12 to load (4 fertiliser, 1 coal, 5 steel, 2 coal). 6 To discharge (1 citrus, 1 alumina, 2 sunflower seeds, 1 miscellaneous, 1 equipment). 3 To discharge/load containers.

Odessa - 21 Vessels in port operating of which 9 loading (1 fertiliser, 4 metal, 3 sunflower seeds, oil). 1 Discharging rice, 1 scientific vessel, 3 under repairs, 3 waiting. 4 Passenger vessels, 6 vessels waiting in roads of which 5 to load (1 sunflower seeds, 1 paper, 1 metal, 2 oil), 1 awaiting cargo documents. 17 Vessels due of which 11 to load (1 barley, 5 metal, 1 cellulose, 2 fertiliser, 2 sunflower seeds). 4 To discharge (1 general cargo, 1 citrus, 1 wheat, 1 rice). 2 To discharge/load containers. Jan 14 - Odessa - Steel cargoes (loading), 5 vessels berthed, 5 due. Containers, 3 vessels due. Grain cargoes (loading), 3 vessels berthed, 1 anchored, 4 due. Tankers (loading), 1 vessel berthed, 1 anchored, 1 due. General cargo, 2 berthed, 1 anchored, 3 due. Fertiliser, 1 berthed, 2 due. Ilychevsk - Steel cargoes (loading), 6 vessels berthed. Containers, 2 vessels berthed. General cargo, 4 vessels berthed, 1 anchored.

YUGOSLAVIA, Jan 14 - Bar - Nine vessels berthed of which 5 discharging (2 bananas, 1 humanitarian aid, 1 diesel oil, 1 petcoke). 4 Loading (2 steel coils, 1 containers, 1 aluminium t bars). 6 Ferries on the lines. Bar-Bari-Bar, Bar-Trieste-Koper-Bar - No delays. Zelenika/Vgjia - Three vessels berthed, no commercial operations. 2 Vessels under repair.
